import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext

set_option autoImplicit false
universe u
open CategoryTheory TensorProduct
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]

structure StableGluePackage
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k] where
  context : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F

namespace StableGluePackage
variable {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
abbrev L (P : StableGluePackage C F) := P.context.models.L
abbrev n (P : StableGluePackage C F) := P.context.models.n
abbrev m (P : StableGluePackage C F) := P.context.models.m
abbrev relation (P : StableGluePackage C F) := P.context.models.relation
abbrev e (P : StableGluePackage C F) := P.context.models.e
abbrev M (P : StableGluePackage C F) := P.context.models.M
abbrev mapM (P : StableGluePackage C F) := P.context.models.mapM
abbrev N (P : StableGluePackage C F) := P.context.triple.N
abbrev thetaN (P : StableGluePackage C F) := P.context.triple.thetaN
def comparison (P : StableGluePackage C F) (q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C) :=
  P.context.models.comparison q
def hOpen (P : StableGluePackage C F) (i : Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex C) :=
  P.context.models.openImmersion i
def hthetaN (P : StableGluePackage C F)
    (p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C) :=
  P.context.triple.comparison p

example (P : StableGluePackage C F) (i : Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex C) :
    IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (P.mapM (Sum.inl i)).toRingHom)) := P.hOpen i

end StableGluePackage
end
end AlgebraicGeometry
